name: decision-pack
title: Diligence decision pack: private draft
for_each: select id,name from deals order by name

sections.title: Requests and reviews
sections.sql: select name,workstream,owner,due,state,evidence,reviewer,review_note from requests where deal_id=$1 order by due

sections.title: Findings
sections.sql: select name,severity,detail,state,resolution from findings where deal_id=$1 order by due

sections.title: Privacy prompts
sections.sql: select rule,record,issue from compliance_gaps where deal_id=$1

name: handover-plan
title: Integration handover plan: private draft
for_each: select id,name from deals order by name

sections.title: Agreed actions
sections.sql: select name,owner,due,state,evidence from tasks where deal_id=$1 order by due

sections.title: Deal notes
sections.sql: select actor,body,created_at from notes where deal_id=$1 order by created_at
